description: What the workspace uses of its Ploa plan: the plan, apps and members against its counts, this month's cloud builds on Ploa's machines per platform (included, used, left, and what one past the count costs: on Free builds stop at the count, on paid plans each one past it adds to the next bill), and the web's hosting room (sites, storage, traffic). Read it before a build on Ploa's machines (where: "cloud"), adding an app or inviting a member, and tell the person first when it would cost them or stop. Builds on this machine, on GitHub, in Xcode Cloud or in the person's Google Cloud never count here. Read-only: it buys and changes nothing.
name: ploa_usage_get
title: What the plan has left
